input.question: Are there any characters similar to Achilles in Non-Western Mythology?
input.ground_truth: There's Samson, of course, whose strength increased with the length of his hair. But if you were sneaky and cut off his hair he was powerless. Samson's hair is as Achilles' Styx-hardened skin - both the source of their supernatural strength and their greatest weakness.
